title: China-to-Senegal Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Senegal's national standards body ASN （Agence Senegalaise de Normalisation） generally adopts IEC standards as Senegalese standards （NS）, so the practical electrical-safety reference for hand-held and transportable power tools is NS/IEC 62841. The product must also be rated for the local supply of 230 V, 50 Hz; the 50 Hz frequency matches China but the nominal voltage differs from the common Chinese 220 V / 380 V rating, so voltage rating, plug/cord, and marking should be checked. Any charger or external power supply for a cordless tool is assessed against the relevant adopted IEC charger/PSU standard.
target_standards: NS/IEC 62841 series （ASN-adopted IEC 62841 for hand-held, transportable, and lawn/garden electric motor-operated tools）
Relevant ASN-adopted IEC charger/power-supply standard for the charger or external PSU where applicable
Local supply rating: 230 V, 50 Hz
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series （hand-held motor-operated electric tools） and use CCC certification where the product falls within a CCC-listed scope. GB/T 3883 is itself largely aligned with IEC 62841, so technically the test content is close, but a China domestic report or CCC mark does not by itself satisfy Senegalese PEC import conformity or NS marking expectations.
china_standards: CCC certification where the product is in CCC-listed scope
rows.gap: Because GB/T 3883 and NS/IEC 62841 share an IEC 62841 base, the technical gap is usually small, but two practical gaps remain: voltage/plug rating for 230 V 50 Hz Senegalese supply versus China's 220 V/380 V, and the need to route safety evidence through Senegal's PEC import-conformity procedure with French-language documentation rather than relying on a CCC mark.

target.en: Electrical-safety conformity is effectively mandatory in practice through ASN-adopted standards and the PEC/VoC import-inspection regime; NS/IEC 62841 is the adopted technical reference rather than a standalone law. Exact mandatory scope should be confirmed against current ASN catalogue entries and Ministry of Trade conformity orders.
target.zh: 电气安全符合性在实务中通过 ASN 采纳的标准及 PEC/VoC 进口检验制度实际上是强制性的；NS/IEC 62841 是采纳的技术参照，而非独立法律。确切强制范围应对照现行 ASN 标准目录及贸易部符合性法令确认。
target.zht: 電氣安全符合性在實務中通過 ASN 採納的標準及 PEC/VoC 進口檢驗制度實際上是強制性的；NS/IEC 62841 是採納的技術參照，而非獨立法律。確切強制範圍應對照現行 ASN 標準目錄及貿易部符合性法令確認。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series, with CCC certification mandatory for in-scope listed products.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，列名范围内产品须强制 CCC 认证。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，列名範圍內產品須強制 CCC 認證。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Likely close on test content because GB/T 3883 and NS/IEC 62841 share an IEC base, but not Senegal-ready until the 230 V 50 Hz voltage/plug rating is confirmed and safety evidence is presented through the PEC import-conformity route with French documentation rather than a CCC mark alone.

source.publisher: International Electrotechnical Commission （IEC 62841 base standard adopted by ASN as NS）

rows.target_requirement: Senegal does not operate an EU-style standalone EMC Directive. In practice EMC is handled through ASN-adopted IEC/CISPR standards （for example the CISPR 14 family for motor-operated and electrical tools） applied via the PEC/VoC import-conformity inspection, and through ARTP spectrum rules for any radio-emitting parts. Motor-driven tools, electronic speed controllers, and chargers should not generate excessive disturbance and should have adequate immunity, but the legal hook is the conformity/import-inspection regime rather than a dedicated EMC law.
target_standards: ASN-adopted IEC/CISPR EMC standards （for example CISPR 14 family for motor-operated/electrical tools） applied via PEC/VoC
ARTP spectrum rules for any radio-emitting components （see market/radio row）
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports （often GB 4343 / CISPR 14 aligned） alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports. Because both China and Senegal can reference the same CISPR base, the technical limits are usually comparable, but the test configuration, charger inclusion, worst-case modes, and acceptance by the PEC inspection body still need Senegal-specific confirmation.
china_standards: GB 4343 / CISPR 14-aligned China EMC standards where applicable
rows.gap: The technical gap is usually small because both sides can lean on CISPR 14. The real gap is procedural: whether the EMC evidence covers the actual marketed configuration （tool plus charger plus battery） and whether it is accepted within the PEC/VoC import-conformity dossier in French rather than only as a China domestic report.

target.en: There is no dedicated Senegalese EMC law equivalent to the EU EMC Directive. EMC expectations are enforced indirectly through ASN-adopted CISPR/IEC standards under the PEC/VoC import-conformity regime and, for radio parts, through ARTP. Exact applicability should be confirmed against current ASN and Ministry of Trade conformity references.
target.zh: 塞内加尔没有等同于欧盟 EMC 指令的专门 EMC 法律。EMC 要求通过 ASN 采纳的 CISPR/IEC 标准在 PEC/VoC 进口符合性制度下间接执行，无线电部件另经 ARTP 管理。确切适用性应对照现行 ASN 及贸易部符合性参照确认。
target.zht: 塞內加爾沒有等同於歐盟 EMC 指令的專門 EMC 法律。EMC 要求通過 ASN 採納的 CISPR/IEC 標準在 PEC/VoC 進口符合性制度下間接執行，無線電部件另經 ARTP 管理。確切適用性應對照現行 ASN 及貿易部符合性參照確認。

cn.en: China domestic files may include CISPR 14-aligned EMC evidence （e.g. GB 4343） where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件在适用时可包含与 CISPR 14 对齐的 EMC 证据（例如 GB 4343）。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件在適用時可包含與 CISPR 14 對齊的 EMC 證據（例如 GB 4343）。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] EMC test content is likely comparable given a shared CISPR 14 base, but Senegal has no standalone EMC law; treat EMC as enforced through PEC/VoC import conformity and ARTP for radio, and confirm the evidence covers the full marketed tool-plus-charger system in French.

source.publisher: ARTP （Autorite de Regulation des Telecommunications et des Postes, Senegal） for radio aspects; CISPR/IEC for EMC test basis

rows.requirement: Market Access: ASN/PEC Conformity, Import Inspection, and ARTP Radio
rows.target_requirement: Senegal manages market access through ASN-set national standards （NS, largely adopting IEC） and a Ministry of Trade conformity / import-inspection regime commonly described as PEC （Programme d'Evaluation de la Conformite） or Verification of Conformity （VoC）, with goods cleared via the port of Dakar. Documentation is expected in French. For cordless power tools that contain a radio transmitter （for example wireless control or Bluetooth）, type approval/authorisation from ARTP is additionally required. Occupational and electrical-safety frameworks may also apply to the use of such tools.
target_standards: ASN national standards （NS, largely adopting IEC）
Ministry of Trade PEC （Programme d'Evaluation de la Conformite） / Verification of Conformity （VoC） import inspection
ARTP type approval/authorisation for radio-emitting cordless tools
Port of Dakar customs clearance; French-language documentation
Applicable occupational/electrical-safety framework
rows.china_equivalent: For China placement, the comparable baseline is CCC certification for in-scope listed power tools plus GB/T 3883 safety evidence, and domestic radio type approval （SRRC） for wireless modules. None of these Chinese marks or approvals is recognised automatically in Senegal; they must be re-routed through the PEC/VoC conformity dossier and, for radio, through ARTP.
china_standards: CCC certification for in-scope listed power tools
SRRC radio type approval for wireless modules
rows.gap: A China CCC mark, GB/T 3883 report, or SRRC approval does not grant Senegalese market access. The importer needs a PEC/VoC conformity dossier accepted at Dakar import inspection, French-language documentation, NS/IEC-referenced safety evidence, and a separate ARTP authorisation for any radio-emitting cordless tool.

target.en: Mandatory in practice: clearing imported power tools through the Ministry of Trade PEC/VoC conformity and import-inspection regime, with French documentation; ARTP authorisation is mandatory for radio-emitting cordless tools. ASN NS standards are the adopted technical references. Exact procedure, designated inspection body, and document set should be confirmed against current Senegalese rules.
target.zh: 实务强制：进口电动工具须经贸易部 PEC/VoC 符合性与进口检验制度清关，并附法语文件；无线电发射无绳工具须强制取得 ARTP 许可。ASN 的 NS 标准为采纳的技术参照。确切程序、指定检验机构及文件清单应对照现行塞内加尔规则确认。
target.zht: 實務強制：進口電動工具須經貿易部 PEC/VoC 符合性與進口檢驗制度清關，並附法語文件；無線電發射無繩工具須強制取得 ARTP 許可。ASN 的 NS 標準為採納的技術參照。確切程序、指定檢驗機構及文件清單應對照現行塞內加爾規則確認。

cn.en: Mandatory China baseline: CCC for in-scope listed tools, GB/T 3883 safety evidence, and SRRC for wireless modules.
cn.zh: 中国强制基线：列名范围工具的 CCC、GB/T 3883 安全证据，以及无线模块的 SRRC。
cn.zht: 中國強制基線：列名範圍工具的 CCC、GB/T 3883 安全證據，以及無線模組的 SRRC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Senegal-ready on Chinese marks alone: clear the tool through the PEC/VoC import-conformity regime at Dakar with French documentation and NS/IEC-referenced safety evidence, and obtain ARTP authorisation for any radio-emitting cordless model.

source.publisher: ARTP （Autorite de Regulation des Telecommunications et des Postes, Senegal）; ASN national standards body; Senegal Ministry of Trade PEC/VoC

rows.requirement: Outdoor Noise: No EU-Style Product Marking Regime
rows.target_requirement: Senegal does not operate an EU-style horizontal outdoor-noise product regime equivalent to Directive 2000/14/EC, so there is no Senegal-specific guaranteed sound-power marking or noise conformity-assessment obligation attached to the power tool itself at import. Noise is instead addressed, if at all, through general occupational health-and-safety and environmental frameworks governing workplace exposure and ambient noise, not through a product-level marking mandate. Any IEC-based declared sound/vibration figures in the technical file are informational and may still be expected as part of the safety documentation under NS/IEC 62841.
target_standards: No Senegalese equivalent to EU Directive 2000/14/EC outdoor-noise product marking
General occupational health-and-safety and environmental noise frameworks （workplace/ambient exposure, not product marking）
Sound/vibration declarations under NS/IEC 62841 are informational technical-file content
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files under GB/T 3883 focus on electrical and mechanical hazards and typically report noise and vibration emission values for information rather than as a separate marking certificate. There is likewise no Chinese product-level outdoor-noise marking mandate equivalent to the EU one for these tools.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series （reports noise/vibration emission values for information）
rows.gap: Honestly stated, there is no Senegal-versus-China product-marking gap here because neither side imposes an EU-style outdoor-noise marking duty on these power tools. Exporters carrying an EU 2000/14/EC noise dossier should note it is not required for Senegal, while declared noise/vibration figures may still be useful safety-documentation content. Workplace noise-exposure duties, if any, fall on the user/employer under occupational frameworks, not on the imported product mark.

target.en: No mandatory product-level outdoor-noise marking obligation identified for power tools in Senegal （no Directive 2000/14/EC equivalent）. General occupational/environmental noise rules may apply to use, not to product import marking. Confirm against current Senegalese labour and environmental law if a specific project involves high-noise equipment.
target.zh: 未发现塞内加尔对电动工具有强制性产品级户外噪声标识义务（无指令 2000/14/EC 等价物）。一般职业/环境噪声规则可能适用于使用环节，而非产品进口标识。若具体项目涉及高噪声设备，应对照现行塞内加尔劳动和环境法确认。
target.zht: 未發現塞內加爾對電動工具有強制性產品級戶外噪聲標識義務（無指令 2000/14/EC 等價物）。一般職業/環境噪聲規則可能適用於使用環節，而非產品進口標識。若具體項目涉及高噪聲設備，應對照現行塞內加爾勞動和環境法確認。

cn.en: No equivalent Chinese product-level outdoor-noise marking mandate for these tools; noise/vibration values are reported for information under GB/T 3883.
cn.zh: 中国对这些工具同样没有产品级户外噪声标识强制；噪声/振动值按 GB/T 3883 以信息形式报告。
cn.zht: 中國對這些工具同樣沒有產品級戶外噪聲標識強制；噪聲/振動值按 GB/T 3883 以資訊形式報告。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No outdoor-noise product-marking gap: Senegal has no Directive 2000/14/EC equivalent, so an EU noise dossier is not required for Senegal; keep declared noise/vibration figures as informational safety content and treat any noise-exposure duty as an occupational/environmental matter for the user.

source.publisher: IEC 62841 （declared noise/vibration method, adopted as NS）; no Senegalese 2000/14/EC-equivalent product regime identified

rows.requirement: Restricted Substances: No EU-Style RoHS Regime
rows.target_requirement: Senegal does not operate a horizontal EU-style RoHS regime equivalent to Directive 2011/65/EU restricting hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment at product level. There is therefore no Senegal-specific RoHS declaration or homogeneous-material conformity obligation attached to the power tool at import. General chemical, environmental, and waste-management rules may apply, and ECOWAS-level or international chemical conventions to which Senegal is a party can be relevant, but these are not an EU-equivalent product RoHS mark.
target_standards: No Senegalese equivalent to EU Directive 2011/65/EU （RoHS）
General chemical/environmental/waste-management rules where applicable
ECOWAS-level or international chemical conventions to which Senegal is a party where relevant
rows.china_equivalent: China operates its own China RoHS administrative regime （hazardous-substance marking and disclosure for electrical/electronic products） alongside GB/T 3883 safety evidence. China RoHS material data can be reused as supporting evidence, but it maps to Chinese rules, not to any Senegalese product-level restricted-substances mandate.
china_standards: China RoHS administrative measures for electrical/electronic products
rows.gap: Honestly stated, there is no Senegal product-level restricted-substances marking to comply with, so an exporter cannot be non-compliant against a RoHS regime that Senegal does not have. China RoHS material declarations remain useful supporting data, but the exporter should not assume an EU RoHS dossier is required for Senegal, nor that the absence of one blocks Senegalese market access.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style RoHS product obligation identified for power tools in Senegal. General chemical/environmental law may apply but does not create an EU-equivalent restricted-substances product mark. Confirm against current Senegalese and ECOWAS chemical/environmental rules for specific substances of concern.
target.zh: 未发现塞内加尔对电动工具有强制性的欧盟式 RoHS 产品义务。一般化学品/环境法可能适用，但不产生欧盟等价的限用物质产品标识。对于特定关注物质，应对照现行塞内加尔及 ECOWAS 化学品/环境规则确认。
target.zht: 未發現塞內加爾對電動工具有強制性的歐盟式 RoHS 產品義務。一般化學品/環境法可能適用，但不產生歐盟等價的限用物質產品標識。對於特定關注物質，應對照現行塞內加爾及 ECOWAS 化學品/環境規則確認。

cn.en: China RoHS administrative marking/disclosure applies to in-scope electrical/electronic products domestically.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 行政标识/披露在境内适用于列名范围的电气电子产品。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 行政標識/披露在境內適用於列名範圍的電氣電子產品。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No RoHS product gap: Senegal has no Directive 2011/65/EU equivalent, so an EU RoHS dossier is not a Senegal market-access condition; reuse China RoHS material data as supporting evidence and verify only general chemical/environmental rules for specific substances.

source.publisher: No Senegalese RoHS-equivalent product regime identified; reference frameworks are general chemical/environmental and ECOWAS/international conventions

rows.requirement: Cordless Tool Batteries: No EU-Style Battery Regulation
rows.target_requirement: Senegal does not operate an EU-style horizontal battery regime equivalent to Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 （battery CE marking, carbon footprint, due diligence, removability/replaceability, battery passport）. For cordless power tools, the lithium battery pack is therefore handled mainly through general product safety/electrical-safety expectations under ASN-adopted IEC standards, lithium-battery transport rules （UN 38.3 for shipping）, and the PEC/VoC import-conformity dossier, rather than a dedicated battery-product law. Where the cordless tool also contains radio, ARTP applies to the radio function, not to the battery itself.
target_standards: No Senegalese equivalent to Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 battery-product regime
ASN-adopted IEC battery/charger safety standards via PEC/VoC where applicable
UN 38.3 lithium-battery transport testing （shipping requirement）
PEC/VoC import-conformity dossier
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files commonly treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, supported by lithium-battery safety standards （e.g. GB 31241） and UN 38.3 transport evidence. This evidence maps reasonably to Senegal's general-safety-plus-transport approach, since Senegal imposes no broader EU-style battery economic-operator or passport duties.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series （battery pack tested as accessory）
rows.gap: Honestly stated, there is no EU-style battery-product compliance gap for Senegal: a battery pack supported by GB 31241 safety and UN 38.3 transport evidence aligns with Senegal's general-safety-plus-transport-plus-PEC approach. The exporter should not assume EU Battery Regulation labelling, conformity assessment, removability analysis, or a battery passport is required for Senegal, while keeping transport-safety and basic battery-safety evidence in the import dossier.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style battery-product regulation identified for cordless tools in Senegal. Practical mandatory elements are lithium-battery transport safety （UN 38.3） for shipping and general product/electrical safety via the PEC/VoC import dossier. Confirm any battery-import or waste-battery rules against current Senegalese law for the specific shipment.
target.zh: 未发现塞内加尔对无绳工具有强制性的欧盟式电池产品法规。实务强制要素是运输用锂电池运输安全（UN 38.3）以及经 PEC/VoC 进口档案的一般产品/电气安全。任何电池进口或废电池规则应就具体货物对照现行塞内加尔法律确认。
target.zht: 未發現塞內加爾對無繩工具有強制性的歐盟式電池產品法規。實務強制要素是運輸用鋰電池運輸安全（UN 38.3）以及經 PEC/VoC 進口檔案的一般產品/電氣安全。任何電池進口或廢電池規則應就具體貨物對照現行塞內加爾法律確認。

cn.en: China baseline: battery pack under GB/T 3883 as accessory, GB 31241 lithium-battery safety, and UN 38.3 transport evidence where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国基线：电池包按 GB/T 3883 作为附件、GB 31241 锂电池安全，以及适用的 UN 38.3 运输证据。
cn.zht: 中國基線：電池包按 GB/T 3883 作為附件、GB 31241 鋰電池安全，以及適用的 UN 38.3 運輸證據。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style battery-product gap: Senegal has no Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 equivalent, so keep lithium-battery transport （UN 38.3） and basic battery-safety （e.g. GB 31241/IEC） evidence in the PEC import dossier and do not assume EU battery labelling, conformity assessment, or a battery passport is a Senegal market-access condition.

source.publisher: UNECE （UN 38.3 lithium-battery transport）; no Senegalese EU-2023/1542-equivalent battery-product regime identified
